The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Mandatory Compliance: The bidder shall strictly comply with all the technical specifications, quantities, terms and conditions stipul ated in the Bid/BOQ. Any deviation from the stipulated requirement shall be clearly indicated by the bidder in its offer. New & Genuine Equipment: All equipment supplied shall be brand new, unused, genuine, original and of current/latest available model . Refurbished, reconditioned, used or obsolete equipment shall not be accepted. Complete Supply: The bidder shall be responsible for supply of the complete and functional system, including all standard ac cessories, cables, connectors, power cords, adapters, drivers, software and other essential components re quired for proper operation. No additional payment shall be admissible for such essential components. Installation & Commissioning – Mandatory: The successful bidder shall personally arrange deployment of competent technical personnel at the consig nee's location for installation, configuration, testing and commissioning of all supplied equipment. Mere de livery of the equipment shall not constitute completion of the supply. Testing & Demonstration: Each item shall be thoroughly tested and demonstrated to the consignee after installation. The bidder shall rectify, at its own cost, any defect, configuration issue or non-functioning observed during installation

/testing. Compatibility & Integration: The bidder shall ensure proper compatibility, interoperability and integration of the supplied equipment wi th the required existing infrastructure, wherever applicable. Any configuration/accessory required for achie ving proper functioning shall be provided by the bidder without any additional cost. Technical Support: The successful bidder shall provide necessary technical assistance and after-sales support during the warr anty period. The bidder shall nominate an authorised technical representative/service contact for coordina tion and service requirements. Warranty: All equipment shall carry the OEM's comprehensive warranty for the period specified in the Bid/BOQ. Warr anty shall cover repair/replacement of defective parts/components as applicable, without additional cost to the consignee. Service Responsibility: In case of any malfunction/failure during the warranty period, the bidder shall undertake necessary correct ive action within a reasonable time from receipt of complaint, including deployment of technical personnel wherever required. OEM/Authorised Channel: The bidder shall ensure that the equipment supplied is sourced through the OEM or its authorised channel, wherever applicable, and shall furnish supporting documents when required by the consignee. Documentation: The bidder shall provide all applicable warranty certificates, user manuals, installation documents, technic al literature and other relevant documents along with the equipment. Acceptance: Final acceptance of the equipment shall be subject to successful delivery, installation, configuration, testin g, demonstration and satisfactory commissioning at the consignee's location. The consignee shall have the right to withhold acceptance of any equipment not conforming to the stipulated requirements. Responsibility for Non-Conformity: Any equipment found to be defective, damaged, non-genuine, non-conforming or not meeting the stipulate d specifications shall be replaced/rectified by the bidder at its own cost and risk. No Extra Cost: All expenditure towards transportation, delivery, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing, demon stration and necessary technical support shall be deemed to be included in the quoted price, unless specifi cally stated otherwise in the Bid/BOQ. Declaration of Compliance: The bidder shall submit a point-wise compliance statement against the technical specifications and ATC. S ubmission of bid shall be deemed to constitute acceptance of all stipulated ATC, unless a specific deviation is expressly declared by the bidder. Right of Rejection: The consignee reserves the right to reject any equipment or supply which does not conform to the stipulat ed technic .
